newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin looks pale during Albright meeting.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin looks pale during Albright meeting.

text.p: U.S. Secretary of State Madeleine Albright, on a whirlwind tour of international capitals, met Russian President Boris Yeltsin in the Kremlin on Friday.
Albright was the first Western leader to visit Yeltsin in the Kremlin this year, although Yeltsin received Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat there on Tuesday.

The Russian president has been recovering from pneumonia and two top-level meetings this year -- with German Chancellor Helmut Kohl and with French President Jacques Chirac -- have been in official residences outside Moscow.

Yeltsin's face looked pale and waxen, as if he was wearing make-up. "I welcome you to the Kremlin, to Moscow, on this very responsible visit to work on certain problems that exist between us," he said as the two sat down.
